response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile does not match this role's core requirements. Their C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a university thesis project, far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. They also lack any Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was retail-investment fintech, not capital markets), and there is no evidence of deep SQL Server/Oracle work or Summit platform exposure.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) with systems-level work in DLang and C/C++
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, and DevOps/tooling experience
Experience with low-latency, high-throughput backend systems at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~7 months, a decade ago) versus the mandatory 5–10 years
No Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle depth or Windows-platform development focus

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering fundamentals and low-latency systems background
